expectations.text: Uses the correct 1-D Gaussian KL formula 0.5*[ln(var_q/var_p) + (var_p + (mu_p-mu_q)^2)/var_q - 1] (variances, not std).
expectations.evidence: Uses the std-form formula log(σ_q/σ_p) + (σ_p²+(μ_p-μ_q)²)/(2σ_q²) - ½, which is mathematically equivalent to the variance form. The derivation is correct.

expectations.text: Forward KL(p||q) with var_p=1, var_q=2, mu_p=0, mu_q=1 evaluates to approximately 0.3466 nats (= 0.5 bits exactly).
Reverse KL(q||p) evaluates to approximately 0.6534 nats (= 0.9427 bits). NOT equal to the forward value.
Explicitly states the two values differ, so KL is asymmetric / not a metric.
expectations.evidence: States 'KL divergence is not symmetric'; notes it is a divergence not a distance.

eval_feedback.overall: Both compute correctly. With-skill adds the VI/MLE interpretation of the asymmetry. Eval 10d could require naming the direction (mode-seeking vs mass-covering) for a stronger discriminator.
